title: Password reset loop
customer_report: I reset my password but it keeps sending me back to reset it again.
expected_behavior: User reaches dashboard after successful reset
actual_behavior: User is redirected to reset-password again

title: Duplicate subscription charge
customer_report: I only bought one Pro plan but my card shows two charges.
expected_behavior: One successful purchase creates one charge
actual_behavior: Retry after timeout can create two successful charges

title: Save button missing on mobile
customer_report: I can't save my profile on my phone.
expected_behavior: Save action remains reachable on supported mobile viewport
actual_behavior: Save button is rendered outside viewport

title: Restricted billing page visible
customer_report: A normal team member can open our billing details from an old link.
expected_behavior: Non-billing members cannot access billing details
actual_behavior: Direct URL returns billing page content

title: CSV export date format wrong
customer_report: Our export changed dates to US format.
actual_behavior: Dates export as MM/DD/YYYY

title: Invite email not received
customer_report: I invited a teammate three times and nothing arrived.
actual_behavior: Message delayed by provider spam filtering

title: Dark mode request
customer_report: Can you add automatic dark mode based on my system setting?
actual_behavior: Only manual theme switch exists

title: Dashboard slow after login
customer_report: The dashboard takes almost a minute to load today.
actual_behavior: API latency elevated across accounts

title: Wrong timezone in activity log
customer_report: Events are five hours off for our Brazil team.
actual_behavior: Log renders UTC timestamps

title: Can't delete workspace
customer_report: The delete button does nothing.
actual_behavior: Click blocked by content blocker extension

title: Need SSO with another provider
customer_report: We need Okta SAML before rollout.
actual_behavior: Only Google and Azure SSO are currently supported

title: Invoice download returns 500
customer_report: Downloading our August invoice gives an error.
actual_behavior: Request returns HTTP 500 for one generated invoice

title: Search finds deleted projects
customer_report: Deleted projects still appear in search.
expected_behavior: Deleted projects are excluded from search
actual_behavior: Search index still returns deleted records for up to 10 minutes

title: Two-factor code rejected
customer_report: My authenticator code is always invalid.
expected_behavior: Valid current TOTP code is accepted
actual_behavior: Device clock is 4 minutes out of sync

title: Attachment upload hangs
customer_report: A 45 MB PDF never finishes uploading.
actual_behavior: Upload stalls at 99 percent for PDFs above ~40 MB

title: Keyboard shortcut request
customer_report: Can we get a shortcut to create a ticket from anywhere?
actual_behavior: No global create-ticket shortcut exists

title: Notification preferences reset
customer_report: My email notification settings keep turning back on.
actual_behavior: Preferences revert after organization policy sync

title: Login occasionally fails
customer_report: Sometimes I get a blank page after sign in but I can't make it happen now.
actual_behavior: Intermittent blank page reported without request ID

title: API returns 503
customer_report: Our integration started getting 503s this morning.
expected_behavior: API requests return normal success responses
actual_behavior: Shared dependency outage causes elevated 503 responses

title: Avatar looks blurry
customer_report: My profile photo looks a little blurry in the sidebar.
expected_behavior: Avatar renders crisply at supported sizes
actual_behavior: 32px thumbnail appears soft on high-DPI displays
